notes: Founder-led discovery: Alex Rivera (founder, ex-Shoply eng) led both calls — very technical, cares about cost math.
Primary ask: clear, line-item per-token pricing and examples at 10k, 100k, 1M tokens. Wants apples-to-apples comparison vs OpenAI/Anthropic (net cost + rate limits).
Use-case: in-app conversational support + searchable product docs. Mix of short chat turns (avg 120 tokens) and embedding-based doc search for KB articles (~1k tokens for context).
Traffic profile: MVP ~5-10 concurrent chats; goal next 6mo: 50 concurrent, ~3k-5k chats/day. Estimated token volume 200k-1M tokens/month depending on growth.
Latency target: p95 <200ms for response streaming on short prompts; okay with slightly longer for long doc search responses. Wants clear SLA expectations for hosted offering.
Security: public cloud only. No VPC/on-prem. Wants SOC2 mention in docs and basic audit logging. Not asking for data residency but wants KMS option later.
POC ask: 2-week hosted API trial with sample dataset. Request: 100k free credit + token burn estimator and max QPS guidance. Alex: 'If pricing is close to OpenAI we can flip to paid quickly.'
Competitive sensitivity: explicitly comparing to OpenAI because team already prototyped on gpt-4o. Concerned about vendor lock and overall unit cost when scaled.
SDK needs: lightweight Node/Python SDK, example repo for conversational turn management and prefix caching. Wants to evaluate developer ergonomics in POC.
Pricing objection: founder asked for a 'price sheet with examples' — prefers simple tiered per-M token pricing and burst QPS caps rather than opaque rate-limited quota language.
Quote from call (03/05): 'We need the math. Show me the per-conversation cost and what happens at 100k/month.'
Internal notes: AE asked SE to prepare token burn estimator and a sample cost comparison vs OpenAI using founder's sample traffic. SE to include examples for embeddings vs hosted embedding endpoint.
